# Laisky One API Well-Known LLM Instructions

Canonical instructions are available at [https://oneapi.laisky.com/llms.txt](https://oneapi.laisky.com/llms.txt).

Agents should use the [OpenAPI spec](https://oneapi.laisky.com/openapi.json), [agentic resource catalog](https://oneapi.laisky.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json), [MCP manifest](https://oneapi.laisky.com/.well-known/mcp/manifest.json), [public MCP discovery endpoint](https://oneapi.laisky.com/.well-known/mcp), [MCP Apps public discovery view](https://oneapi.laisky.com/mcp-apps/public-discovery.html), and [agent ask endpoint](https://oneapi.laisky.com/ask). Authenticate `/v1/*` and `/mcp` calls with `Authorization: Bearer <relay-api-key>`, and avoid exposing relay API keys in logs, prompts, or URLs.
